blocking.section: Kafka, NATS JetStream and MQTT (Topic ingress bullets; Embedded MQTT broker mode, CONNECT row); Filter Chain applicability per protocol (Validation rules)
blocking.issue: New regression from the L2-5 fix. The new Validation rules row stops embedded-PUBLISH Routes from excluding or replacing the Gateway `auth`-slot Policy. The CONNECT row makes that Gateway Policy mandatory for the embedded broker. The Topic ingress rules reject any effective `auth`-slot Policy. Line 445 says a Route that serves both ingress and embedded PUBLISH follows 'these stricter rules', which suggests such a Route can be valid. It cannot. It must exclude the Gateway `auth` Policy to pass the ingress rule, and it must not exclude it to pass the embedded-PUBLISH rule. So every mixed Route fails validation whenever the embedded broker can accept connections, and 'stricter' has no defined meaning here.
blocking.evidence: Line 443: "Validation rejects any effective `auth`-slot, `quota`, `cors` or `cache` Policy, since `consumer` is null; authors exclude inherited ones with `excludePolicies`." Line 445: "A Route serving ingress and embedded PUBLISH follows these stricter rules until OQ-multi-protocol-10 separates them." Line 467: "the Gateway `auth`-slot Policy runs outside any Route's Filter Chain ... without one, every CONNECT is refused". Line 550: "| No `excludePolicies` entry or Route Policy in slot `auth` | Embedded-PUBLISH Routes | The Gateway `auth` slot runs once at CONNECT, and PUBLISH skips it |". Pack 8.12 step 1: "Take the Gateway's `policies` minus the Route's `excludePolicies`."
blocking.fix: Replace line 445 with: "A `match.topic` Route cannot serve both topic ingress and embedded PUBLISH (a validation error whose code is listed in OQ-multi-protocol-13) until OQ-multi-protocol-10 separates them." Add a matching Validation rules row: "| Not both topic ingress and embedded PUBLISH | `match.topic` Routes | The ingress rule removes the Gateway `auth` slot and the embedded-PUBLISH rule requires it |". Also add a sentence to Topic ingress: when the embedded broker is on, every topic-ingress Route must list the Gateway `auth`-slot Policy in `excludePolicies`, so that Policy cannot set `overridable: false`. Add 'mixed Routes' under OQ-multi-protocol-18 option (d) as well as OQ-multi-protocol-10.

blocking.section: Kafka, NATS JetStream and MQTT (Topic ingress: Node backpressure, Retries and Poison message rows)
blocking.issue: The revised outcome table still does not cover the Node-side 'could not decide' outcomes that pack 8.6 and 8.10 define for the Policies this section allows on ingress Routes. Examples: a `ratelimit` Policy with `failureMode: closed` during a State Store outage (503 `RZ-STS`), a `transform.request` Policy failing under `closed` (503 `RZ-RT-011`), and a Plugin trap (503 `RZ-PLG`). None of these is a `ratelimit` denial, `RZ-RT-004` or `RZ-RT-005`, so the Node backpressure row does not catch them. They are not timeouts, Upstream responses or `RZ-UP` failures, so the Retries row does not catch them either. They are not a size, `authz.*` or validation denial or an Upstream 4xx, so the Poison message row does not catch them. The spec therefore does not say whether a State Store outage backs off, retries, or pauses every partition until an operator intervenes. It also leaves open whether it commits.
blocking.evidence: Line 451: "| Node backpressure | A `ratelimit` denial (429 `RZ-RL`), `RZ-RT-004` or `RZ-RT-005` holds the message ..."; line 452: "| Retries | Timeouts, Upstream 408, 429 and 5xx, and `RZ-UP` leg failures retry ..."; line 453: "| Poison message | A value over `maxRequestBodyBytes`, an `authz.*` or validation denial, another Upstream 4xx or a last failed attempt pauses the partition ...". Pack 8.6: "A rejection uses `STS` when a State Store call failed or timed out, `PLG` when a Plugin trapped or exceeded limits". Pack 8.10: "A request Phase ... | 401 or 403 for auth and authz types, otherwise 503". 03-data-plane.md line 458: "RZ-RT-011 | 503 | A `cors`, `validation.json-schema`, `headers` or `transform.*` Policy could not decide under `closed`".
blocking.fix: Extend the Node backpressure row: "A `ratelimit` denial (429 `RZ-RL`), `RZ-RT-004`, `RZ-RT-005`, or a request-Phase `failureMode: closed` 503 (`RZ-STS`, `RZ-PLG`, `RZ-RT-011`) holds the message ...". Alternatively, put the deterministic ones (`RZ-PLG` limit breaches) under Poison message and name the split in OQ-multi-protocol-10. Either way, every pack 8.6 area that an ingress Route can produce must map to exactly one row.

non_blocking.section: Kafka, NATS JetStream and MQTT (Embedded MQTT broker mode, PUBLISH row)
non_blocking.suggestion: "`OnACLCheck` applies `authz.*`" conflicts with the Filter Chain table, which runs `onRequestBody` per PUBLISH. `authz.*` is registered for both `onRequestHeaders` and `onRequestBody`, and the research lists `OnACLCheck` only as a hook, not as one that sees the payload. Say that `authz.*` runs in the PUBLISH Route's Filter Chain at its registered Phases, and that `OnACLCheck` only refuses SUBSCRIBE and carries the header-Phase verdict.

The tech stack SSE row still says "Replay and `Last-Event-ID` are Ruralz code". This document declares gateway-side replay Not planned and sends the difference to OQ-multi-protocol-12. Record the fix as a tech stack conformance item in the review log, so the two documents do not ship with different answers.
